description: Tag vocabulary for the SED2 test suite. 'component' tags name the SED2 elements present in a document and are generated by generate_tags.py. 'semantic' tags describe what a test is about and are chosen by the test author.

tags.aggregationCalculation: Reduces dimensional data by an aggregation calculation (sum, average, standard deviation, etc.).
tags.boundedODESimulation: Like ExplicitODESimulation, but defines only a start/end Span (independentVariableSpan) rather than a fully-explicit range - the solver chooses its own output points, typically denser where the simulation is changing rapidly and sparser where it is slow.
tags.boundedStochasticSimulation: A stochastic simulation (see ExplicitStochasticSimulation) where only the start/end times are defined via the child independentVariableSpan (Span); between those points the simulator may output whenever it wishes - typically at every stochastic event, though taskParameters can control this if that would be too frequent.
tags.calculation: Performs a calculation written in infix as the math attribute; its id may then be used as that calculation's result elsewhere in the document.
tags.createDataBlock: CreateDataBlock assembles a new block of AnnotatedData from several other pieces of data.
tags.csvImport: CsvImport imports a CSV (or other delimiter-separated-values) file found at location and converts it to a numeric AnnotatedData object.
tags.curve: AbstractCurve is the base class (see auxiliary/AbstractCurve); Curve is its only concrete subclass so far, always pinning _type to "curve" (a ShadedArea subclass, matching SED-ML, is expected to join it later - AbstractCurve's oneOf is generated, so adding that branch needs no edit here).
tags.dataImport: DataImport pulls in a file at location (in the format named by format) and imports it into an AnnotatedData object.
tags.drawFromDistribution: Draws from one of the distributions defined in the SBML distrib package - normal, uniform, bernoulli, binomial, cauchy, chisquare, exponential, gamma, laplace, lognormal, poisson, and rayleigh - named by the distribution attribute, which holds that distribution's http://www.sbml.org/sbml/symbols/distrib/ definitionURL (see core/Types's DistributionURI, kept in sync with schema/predefined-functions.json's distrib registry).
tags.explicitODESimulation: Simulates a model along independentVariable with fully explicit output steps, defined by the child independentVariableRange (a NumericRange).
tags.explicitStochasticSimulation: A stochastic simulation is one where the model's processes (e.g.
tags.fluxBalanceAnalysis: Uses an objective function and reaction rate bounds (both defined within the model itself) to determine the set of reaction rates that maximizes the objective function.
tags.jacobianFull: Calculates the full Jacobian matrix of a model - a species-by-species matrix, with identical row and column species orderings.
tags.jacobianReduced: Calculates the reduced Jacobian matrix of a model - a species-by-species matrix over a reduced subset of species, with identical row and column orderings.
tags.loop: A Repeat whose iterations are chained: each depends on the output of the previous one, with one iteration per element of its required range (a Range/NumericRange/ParameterRange), taken in order; a Loop always runs all of them and cannot end early.
tags.modelChange: ModelChange modifies a model (inputModel, an SIdRef to another element's model output) and produces a new model as [id].model.
tags.modelElementList: ModelElementList analyzes a model and returns a list of element-id strings, filtered by includeElements/includeTypes/excludeElements/excludeTypes - four lists of strings whose meaning is defined per model format.
tags.modelImport: Two tasks are designed to import files from an external source: ModelImport and DataImport.
tags.numericRange: A restricted Range (its subclass) whose values are numeric, definable several ways.
tags.oneStepODESimulation: A single-output-point simulation: the values of outputVariables after the independent variable advances by independentStep.
tags.oneStepStochasticSimulation: Similar to OneStepODESimulation, but independentStep is optional.
tags.parameterRange: A NumericRange (its subclass) for when a range of values over a specific model element is needed - most commonly as one of a ParameterScan's parameterRanges.
tags.parameterScan: Runs simulations/analyses over several systematically-varied versions of a model: a Repeat subclass that adds a model child (the model to scan) and one or more ParameterRange children (parameterRanges) - each scanned element adds a dimension to the output.
tags.range: A Range defines a list of values to be taken in sequence.
tags.relabelData: RelabelData replaces the existing labels of the topmost dimension of the referenced input AnnotatedData with the strings given in labels.
tags.report: Exports an AnnotatedData reference (data) for consumption outside the document.
tags.scatter: A Repeat whose iterations are guaranteed fully independent of one another - no subTask output from one iteration feeds into another - so a conforming interpreter may execute the iterations in parallel if it chooses.
tags.span: A minimal range: just a start and an end value, with no explicit intermediate points.
tags.steadyState: Computes the steady state of a model: where dX/dt = 0 for every varying element X of the model, with respect to the independent variable (usually time).
tags.stringFormation: StringFormation takes the concatenate list, converts every element to a string, and concatenates them.
tags.axis: An axis of a Plot2D/Plot3D (xAxis, yAxis, optionally rightYAxis/zAxis).
tags.loopVariable: A named child of a Loop, representing a value that starts at initialValue (sometimes called a 'seed' in workflow languages) on the loop's first iteration, and thereafter takes on subsequentValues - a reference to an output of one of the loop's subTasks.
tags.taskParameter: An algorithm/task parameter attached to a Task's taskParameters list, used to further configure the algorithm identified by the task's _type.
tags.outputParameter: The AbstractOutput counterpart to TaskParameter: an algorithm/output parameter attached to an output's outputParameters list, used to further configure a custom output algorithm identified by the output's _type.
tags.workingAlgorithm: An algorithm used internally by a task, attached via a workingAlgorithms list: the one AbstractSimulation defines (and so every ODE/stochastic simulation task has), or the one SteadyState and FluxBalanceAnalysis each declare directly.
tags.annotation: A single qualifier/value pair attached to any SEDBase-derived element's annotations list, describing the parent object - e.g.
tags.surface: Defines a single 3D surface to plot within a Plot3D's surfaces dictionary - x, y, and z value references plus a surfaceType (parametricCurve, surfaceMesh, surfaceContour, contour, heatMap, stackedCurves, or bar).
tags.style: styles is one of the four optional top-level dictionaries of a SED2 document, referenced from Curve/Surface/Axis children (via their style attribute) to control presentation.
tags.constants: The document defines predefined constants in its constants section.

component.note: A tag is added for every object with a _type (the tag is the _type value). Objects without a _type are tagged through the attribute that holds them (attributeTags).

tags.constants-only: The document has no tasks, only constants and reports.
tags.analytical: The expected results were calculated by hand or from a closed-form solution.
tags.special-values: nan, inf or -inf appear in the data.
tags.string-data: A report or task produces string-valued data.
tags.labeled-data: A report has row or column labels.
tags.multi-dimensional: A report has more than two dimensions (HDF5 result).
tags.variable-step-output: The number and positions of output rows are chosen by the simulator, so results cannot be compared row by row.
tags.backend-subset: Not all of roadrunner, COPASI and OpenCOR can run this test; settings.json lists those that can.

prefixes.sbml: A feature of an SBML input model, e.g. sbml:events, sbml:algebraicRule.
prefixes.csv: A feature of a CSV input file, e.g. csv:columnHeaders.
prefixes.cellml: A feature of a CellML input model.

semantic.note: Tags are added case by case when a test needs one. A tag of the form prefix:name is allowed for any prefix listed here without being listed individually.
